# Scent Studio

> Johannesburg-based luxury perfume boutique specialising in affordable, long-lasting oil-based "Inspired by" designer fragrance dupes. Based at Flora Centre, Roodepoort. Delivery across South Africa.

Scent Studio offers oil-based inspired perfumes (Inspired by Dior Sauvage, Inspired by Baccarat Rouge 540, Inspired by YSL Black Opium and many more) at fair South African prices (R100–R490). Oil-based formulations last 8–12 hours and outperform alcohol-based EDTs in the South African climate.

## Shop
- [Men's Perfumes](/catalog/men): Inspired-by designer men's fragrance dupes — woody, fresh, musky and oud
- [Women's Perfumes](/catalog/women): Inspired-by designer women's fragrance dupes — floral, sweet, fruity and oriental
- [Exclusive Collection](/exclusive): Premium and ultra-premium tier inspired perfumes
- [Craft Your Own](/#signature): Custom blended signature perfume builder
